meta.title: Xynes CMS Console
meta.description: A focused publishing console connected to Xynes Workspace Admin.

hero.headline: Xynes CMS Console
hero.subhead: Write, organize, and publish content in a workspace your editors understand, with Workspace Admin handling access and API keys.
hero.footnote: Session cookies only. No tracking cookies.

directoryFirst.headline: Structure Editors Can Follow
directoryFirst.body: Organize pages, posts, and reusable content around the way your team plans work, so publishing does not depend on tribal knowledge.

workspaceScoped.headline: Connected To Workspace Admin
workspaceScoped.body: Use the same workspace identity, verified domains, and API-key lifecycle your administrators already manage in Xynes Workspace Admin.

openSource.headline: Developer-Ready Delivery
openSource.body: Give developers a clean content API while editors keep a simple console for drafting, publishing, and returning to work quickly.
